messages:
nora (Docs): quick flag: /models/serve endpoint docs list `model_version` as a string enum (`'v1'|'v2'`) in the request body example, but prod expects a nested object `{ id: string, commit: string }`. broke our TS quickstart.

ben (API): thanks — link to the page?

nora (Docs): https://redwood.dev/api-ref#/models/serve request example (body) near examples block. shows `model_version: 'v2'`.

yara (SDK): i saw a crash yesterday. our client types expect `{ id?: string }` but sample enum caused devs to treat it like a simple toggle.

ben (API): ugh, that slipped through when we changed to tracked model artifacts. runtime has accepted object shape since the rollout. docs retained the old enum. my bad.

own (QA): we hit this in the integration harness — requests with string `model_version` returned 400.

nora (Docs): proposed fix: update OpenAPI example to `model_version: { id: "openai/rdw-v2", commit: "c7a9f" }`, update snippets (TS/py) to construct the object, and add a short migration note: "model_version shape changed from enum -> object to support artifact pinning."

yara (SDK): i'll update SDK types and add a helper `pinModel({id,commit})` with a fallback to accept string for one release. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/342

ben (API): i'll update the API example generator to use the object schema and open a tiny middleware to coerce string -> object for leniency (map `'v2'` -> `{id:'rdw-v2', commit: 'latest'}`) so older clients don't break immediately. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/1210

nora (Docs): i'll open docs PR with example + snippet updates and add a changelog entry. aiming for docs deploy tomorrow morning. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/689

docbot: docs deploy scheduled by nora for 2026-04-10T09:00:00-07:00 :calendar:

yara (SDK): merged SDK PR to main, published canary 0.16.0-canary.1. added compatibility test.

ben (API): merged API coercion PR with unit tests.

nora (Docs): merged docs PR, verified new example renders and TS quickstart runs against staging. added support ping + changelog blurb.

docbot: docs deploy completed (v2026-04-10-0900) :white_check_mark: live on staging.

own (QA): re-run harness, all good.

nora (Docs): closing loop — thanks team! will watch for similar enum->object migrations in other endpoints. :tada:
